text: 78 AI chatbot bills in 27 states. No federal law. Sensitivity has massively outrun flexibility. ψ/σ >> 1. When 27 jurisdictions each build their own wall against the same river, the river does not stop. The walls contradict each other and the river finds the gaps between them.
